task_intent: Improve Tessera’s native music wall controls, navigation, and listening surfaces.

references.observed: A pale inset LCD separates album identity from a physical click wheel; the large centre button is visually quiet but unmistakable.
references.applied: High-contrast inset LCD and fixed physical control geometry with accessible alternate reading.

references.observed: The rendered record is the primary object; track identity and small transport controls have a clear supporting hierarchy.
references.applied: Preserve Tessera's rendered player object while separating the physical object from readable external controls.

references.observed: A tactile disc uses engraved detail, a restrained palette and high-contrast rectangular control selections.
references.applied: Engraved player details, decisive LCD menu selection, and clearer wheel press feedback.
Wheel rotation changes the highlighted menu item; Centre selects; Menu backs out; holding Play sleeps the display.
Menu button hit targets are at least 44 points; fixed object text has a scalable external reading view.
Named VoiceOver actions and adjustable values expose wheel functions without circular dragging; colour is supplemented by checkmarks, text and selected traits.
